en: A color postcard showing a mountainous alpine landscape with dramatic rocky peaks in the background, labeled with their local names. A simple open ski‑lift/chairlift crosses the scene above a forest of dark green conifer trees. In the foreground there is a grassy meadow and bright red flowering shrubs. The sky is clear blue with a few clouds. The labels on the peaks identify various summits in the Brenta Dolomites.
